description.value:
Gamorreans are a porcine, tusked humanoid species from the swamp world of Gamorr, organized into a clan-based warrior society that prizes physical strength and martial prowess above all else. Gamorrean males train from childhood in melee combat, favoring axes and vibro-blades, while Gamorrean society is in fact matriarchal, with females governing agriculture, trade, and clan politics.

Off-world, Gamorreans are frequently employed as guards, enforcers, and mercenaries, their imposing bulk and short tempers making them formidable in a brawl.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Savage Fury
traits.description: Once per short or long rest, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage of the weapon's type.

traits.name: Thick Hide
traits.description: Your tough hide grants you resistance to bludgeoning damage from nonmagical, non-adamantine weapons.
